pipeline.title: AI Video Translation & Dubbing Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: An end-to-end 5-stage automated pipeline: from voice isolation, STT transcription, contextual translation with TM, to multi-voice AI dubbing and 3-way QA auditing.
pipeline.runningStatus: Sequential auto-play: Step {{current}}/{{total}} • Hover to pause

stepExtract.headline: Audio Extraction & Original Voice Isolation
stepExtract.details: The system automatically separates audio streams from the source video. Source separation algorithms split the audio into two independent channels: Vocal and Background Music/SFX (BGM), preserving 100% of the original soundscape for subsequent dubbing.

stepStt.headline: Voice-to-Text Transcription with Precise Timestamps
stepStt.details: Automatically detects the source language, transcribes dialogues, and binds timestamps down to millisecond accuracy (start_ms, end_ms). Deep sanity check mechanisms automatically scan for timing drifts and anomaly gaps.

stepTranslate.headline: Smart Localization with TM & Project Glossaries
stepTranslate.details: Translations go through LLM contextual processing while referencing pgvector translation memories to reuse past matches, combined with project glossaries to enforce domain terminology consistency.
stepTranslate.metricPrimaryLabel: Token cost savings via TM Cache

stepDubbing.headline: Natural AI Dubbing & Speech Pace Alignment
stepDubbing.details: Generate natural AI voiceovers in target languages using built-in high-fidelity voice engines (CosyVoice, ElevenLabs, Azure Speech). Automatically time-stretches speech rates to sync seamlessly with video frames without distortion.

stepRender.headline: 3-Way Quality Assurance & High-Res Export
stepRender.details: Automated QA shields detect overlapping lines, reading speed violations (CPS), and screen boundary overflows. Export high-definition video with hardcoded burn-in or standalone subtitle files (.srt, .vtt).

stepSumChunk.headline: Dialogue Recognition & Semantic Grouping
stepSumChunk.details: Extract the full dialogue transcript and automatically cluster content into coherent thematic chunks based on natural pauses and vector semantic similarity.

stepSumCutplan.headline: Core Point Extraction & Automated Cut Planning
stepSumCutplan.details: AI models analyze information density and engagement ratings, ranking the best key moments and constructing second-by-second cut plans for recap generation.

stepSumExport.headline: Highlight Video Rendering & Executive Brief
stepSumExport.details: Automatically stitches highlight moments into a concise 60s - 180s recap video with emphasized keyword subtitles, alongside executive bulleted summary notes.

pipeline.pillarBatchDesc: Orchestrate hundreds of video pipelines simultaneously through RabbitMQ queue workers. Automatically isolates and retries failed stages without rerunning the entire pipeline.
pipeline.pillarTmDesc: Automatically matches similar segments via vector search, reusing past translations to reduce token costs and enforcing domain glossaries.
pipeline.pillarSecurityDesc: Enterprise-grade data protection with end-to-end AES-256 and TLS 1.3 encryption. Zero Retention guarantee — media is never stored permanently or used for AI model training.

stories.title: Empowering Freelancers & Global Creators
stories.subtitle: Hear from independent content creators and freelance video editors streamlining video production every day.

freelancer1.title: “No more sleepless nights manually aligning subtitle timestamps down to the millisecond”
freelancer1.content: Translating a 15-minute video used to take me half a day of listening and manually typing each phrase. With TransFlow, AI pre-generates precise timestamps and initial drafts. I just review terminology and have tripled my project capacity without burnout.
freelancer1.author: Hoang Nam

freelancer2.title: “Client asked to switch voice tone — it took just 1 minute to re-render the TTS stage”
freelancer2.content: The biggest headache in freelance editing is when a client signs off and then says 'can we change to a younger voice?'. With Rerun-from-stage, I just pick a new voice and re-render the TTS step. All aligned subtitles and background tracks stay intact.
freelancer2.author: Minh Trang

freelancer3.title: “Delivered 1 video translated into 4 languages in a single morning without extra hires”
freelancer3.content: A client wanted video releases localized into Thai, Japanese, and Korean. Working alone, I handled the entire project smoothly using Batch Localization, delivering full .srt packages and dubbed high-res videos in a single morning.
freelancer3.author: Tuan Anh

freelancer4.title: “Automated QA gives me total confidence delivering to demanding enterprise clients”
freelancer4.content: Starting out, my biggest fear was overlapping captions or viewers failing to read fast-paced subtitles. TransFlow's 3-way QA shield automatically catches CPS violations and timeline collisions, guaranteeing broadcast-ready standards every time.
freelancer4.author: Thuy Dung

creator1.title: “Turned a 30-minute deep dive into 3 viral Shorts with simple chat prompts”
creator1.content: Starting my Shorts channel, I had no clue which segments would hook viewers. The AI automatically generated smart cut-plans with clean sentence boundaries. Typing 'shorten the intro hook' updated the cut list instantly. Incredibly easy to use.
creator1.author: Duc Huy

creator2.title: “Automatic music separation keeps dubbed voiceovers feeling as cinematic as documentaries”
creator2.content: When doing voiceovers, robotic TTS wiping out ambient acoustics and music was my main worry. Source separation preserves 100% of background audio and auto-ducks during speech, making the final video sound natural and immersive.
creator2.author: Bao Ngoc

creator3.title: “Cut costly editing overhead and published multi-platform video every single day”
creator3.content: As a solo creator on a budget, hiring full-time editors was impossible. TransFlow Media acts like a 24/7 post-production assistant: upload video, select target languages, and export flawless subtitles and voiceovers to stay on daily publishing schedules.
creator3.author: Hai Dang

privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
privacyModal.desc: Our commitment to data privacy and security on TransFlow Media Platform
privacyModal.badgeDesc: TransFlow is designed with data minimization and multi-layered protection from infrastructure to application.
privacyModal.p1Desc: Source videos, extracted audio, voice-overs and rendered videos are kept for at most 3 days after upload, then deleted automatically. Download your results before then; subtitles and translations stay in your workspace.
privacyModal.p2Title: 2. No AI Training on Your Data
privacyModal.p2Desc: TransFlow never uses your content to train AI models. When you use platform AI sources, content is sent to third-party AI providers (possibly on free tiers) under their data policies; use your own API key (BYOK) for full control.
privacyModal.p3Desc: Personal API keys (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, ElevenLabs) are encrypted with AES-256 and never exposed on the Platform Console.
privacyModal.p4Desc: Workspace isolation and 3-tier role permissions (Lead, Member, Client) ensure only authorized team members can access project data.
privacyModal.p5Desc: 100% of network traffic between clients, backend services, and processing workers is encrypted using TLS 1.3.

termsModal.t2Desc: Credits are deducted based on actual processing duration and pipeline stages. Stage rerun allows saving costs by skipping completed work.
termsModal.t3Desc: Users are responsible for ensuring uploaded content complies with copyright laws and applicable regulations.
termsModal.t4Desc: The system provides automated QA checks for timeline collisions and reading speed (CPS). Users retain final publishing approval.
